name: Orson Hyde
role: Early missionary, high councilor, and apostle
dateNote: He was baptized in October 1831 and ordained one of the first Twelve Apostles on 15 February 1835.
importance: Section 68 opens with his call to preach, given at Hiram in November 1831. Sections 75 and 103 send him on missions, and section 100 says he and John Gould are in the Lord’s hands. He was clerk of the first high council, whose minutes became section 102. He sided with dissenters in 1838 but was restored in 1839, and section 124 lists him among the Twelve.
connections: Husband of Marinda Nancy Johnson until 1870. He served with Samuel H. Smith, Orson Pratt, Heber C. Kimball, and Thomas B. Marsh.
reviewNote: Birth, baptism, apostle ordination, 1838 affidavit with Marsh, removal and restoration (1839), missions, and Utah service checked on JSP; death date 28 November 1878 shown only in a citation fragment. Clerk role and Ramus sermon (130) are from the section settings.
